allow: This repo root is a build-pipeline root: the commands that drive a native Bernstein run are routine here. That means bernstein and bernstein-herdr (ready, run-config, gate, run, status, doctor, quarantine), reinstalling the gate with uv tool install, finding the run port with lsof and pgrep, killing leftover bernstein or codex processes, removing .sdd or .agents/build/runs, git worktree add/remove and git worktree prune on this root and its .sdd worktrees, git reset, git checkout of the integration branch to undo a warm-pool spawn that switched the root, and in-place edits of files under .agents/build. The driver never edits application code and never merges to main.
